nodes.title: Historical Workflow Notes
widgets_values:
| MP setting | Safe pass 1 | Pass 2 (1.5x) | Pass 2 latent |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.2 | 576 x 320 | 864 x 480 | 54 x 30 |
| 0.4 | 896 x 512 | 1344 x 768 | 84 x 48 |
| 0.6 | 1024 x 576 | 1536 x 864 | 96 x 54 |

These three pass-1 sizes are multiples of 64. After the fixed 1.5x upscale, pass-2 sizes remain multiples of 32 and both latent dimensions remain even. This preserves aspect ratio and avoids sampler shape/reshape errors. The 0.2 setting uses 576 x 320, closer to 16:9, to reduce the horizontal crop of a 5:3 canvas.

How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Soft pastel anime illustration style, a completely static locked camera at eye level holds the same framing for the full duration. Arona from Blue Archive - a girl with a short blue-white bob (a soft blend of pale blue and white rather than pure white) with faint pink inner layers, a white bunny-ear ribbon headband, a glowing cyan halo, wearing a light-blue long-sleeved uniform top with a white sailor collar and white ribbon bow, a white pleated skirt, white sneakers - stands beside the tall open windows of a sunlit empty classroom, her body facing the window while she glances back over her shoulder toward the viewer, a closed translucent white umbrella held behind her back, a small blue shark plush charm hanging from its handle. She begins in the exact position, pose, expression, and composition established by Picture 1, which also shows rows of wooden desks, a green chalkboard reading "また、あした。", a wall poster reading "やさしく　つよく　きれいに", sheer white curtains billowing inward, and bright sky, clouds, and green trees outside. She performs one complete, extremely slow breathing cycle as if filmed in slow motion: across roughly the first half her shoulders and upper back rise almost imperceptibly, then settle gradually through the second half. In the same gentle rhythm the sheer curtains billow once in a single soft wave that stirs a few loose strands of her hair, then fall still with every fold returning precisely to its original shape. At around 00:02.500, near the top of her breath, she gives one drowsy slow-motion blink, her eyelids closing and reopening smoothly over about one second. A few tiny white petals hover and twirl lazily just inside the window without traveling into the room or crossing the frame, dust motes glitter nearly in place in the light beams, the outdoor leaves sway faintly, and her halo glows with a soft even pulse. Everything else stays perfectly still: desks, chairs, chalkboard writing, poster, bookshelf, floor shadows, weather, and lighting. Through the final second all motion decays to zero - her posture, hair, skirt, the curtain folds, the petals, and her calm gaze converge until the frame lands exactly on the state established by Picture 2 at the 5.00-second mark, which is pixel-for-pixel identical to Picture 1, allowing the clip to loop seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: A hushed empty-classroom ambience continues throughout: a soft breeze breathing through the open windows, the faintest rustle of sheer curtains and tree foliage outside, sparse distant bird chirps, and quiet indoor room tone. No footsteps, no voices, no scraping chairs.

non_diegetic_music: A restrained soft piano pad at a very slow tempo, a few long sustained notes floating at a constant low volume with no swell, no crescendo, and no distinct beginning or ending accent, blending seamlessly when the clip loops.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single uninterrupted 10.13-second painterly 2D-anime live-wallpaper shot begins exactly from Picture 1 and ends exactly on Picture 2. Preserve the exact character identity, composition, pale violet, cyan and white palette, delicate linework, painted chromatic-fringe details, atmospheric depth and translucent materials.

The camera holds a completely Static Shot. Lock camera position, framing, crop, perspective, focal length, focus and depth of field.

The central seated young woman has a short, layered, tousled dark-teal bob ending around the jawline and nape. She does not have long hair: no strand extends below the shoulders, no long rear hair develops, and moving locks never grow into long ribbons. Preserve her head, face, eyes, expression, torso, shoulders, arms, both real hands, visible fingers, legs, seated pose and relationship to the sword. Her body remains motionless, without blinking, visible breathing, facial deformation or pose drift. Preserve only the hands already visible in Picture 1 at their original locations; do not reveal hidden hands or create additional hands.

The vertical sword remains straight, rigid and stationary, preserving its silhouette, hilt, decorations, highlights and position. The lilies preserve their centers, stems and main petals; only a few outer petal tips flutter lightly without crossing the face or sword.

Critical hand definition: the blue-gray shape in the lower-center area immediately left of the sword is the character's real visible hand, rendered with cool blue-gray shading. Preserve its exact anatomical identity and continuous connection to the wrist and sleeve. Preserve one wrist, one palm and five fingers, including the original finger lengths, count, spacing, joints, silhouette, orientation and foreshortening from Picture 1. The wrist and palm remain nearly locked. There is no waving, reaching, grasping, finger opening or curling, independent finger motion, wrist rotation, stretching, duplication or anatomical transformation. Under the strong wind, this hand may undergo only a minute passive sway smaller than one tenth of its own width, visibly much smaller than the nearby cloth motion; its fingers retain the same shape and spacing throughout.

A sustained strong wind flows from right to left with a slight upward lift. It changes only flexible hair, cloth, pale volumetric mist and existing bright particles. It does not independently move anatomical parts and never changes illumination, weather, color grading or shadows.

Lock all hair roots, the short-bob silhouette around the skull and every strand touching the face. Only the short outer and rear tufts flare broadly left and slightly upward. Their tips travel approximately one-third to one-half of the face width in separate smooth arcs with delayed flutter. Preserve their short length, thickness, color and texture. They never merge into a dark mass, cover the face, detach or lengthen below the shoulders.

Preserve fitted clothing and all garment attachment points on the motionless body. The broad loose white panels, translucent outer layers, long cloth edges and narrow ribbons perform large wind-driven billows toward the left. Their free edges travel roughly one-half to one full loose-panel width, lifting slightly before trailing left in broad wave shapes. Panels follow staggered phases with delayed ripples while retaining thickness, transparency, folds and costume connections. The sleeve and loose fabric surrounding the blue-gray hand may flutter, but the sleeve-to-wrist connection remains stable and the cloth never pulls the hand into a large movement. Fabric passes around or behind the character without covering the face, either hand, the sword or central decorations, and no cloth edge merges with or becomes a finger.

The pale foreground volumetric mist along the lower and peripheral edges moves visibly from right to left inside its original depth layer. Soft ribbons travel approximately eight to twelve percent of the frame width and curl slightly upward. It remains pale cyan-white, translucent and softly blurred, moving faster than the background atmosphere. Mist leaving the left boundary is replaced from the right with matching opacity, scale and depth.

Background volumetric mist behind the character, ruins and violet structures drifts left more slowly, traveling approximately three to six percent of the frame width. Long shallow eddies move through its texture while the overall atmospheric envelope remains fixed. Foreground and background mist use different speeds and staggered phases to create depth without camera parallax. Main clouds, railings, ruins, large violet shards and distant architecture remain stationary and stable.

From 0.00 to 2.60 seconds, the wind establishes broad leftward motion in the short hair tufts and loose fabric as foreground mist begins its faster flow and background mist follows. From 2.60 to 6.80 seconds, the strong airflow remains sustained; separate hair tufts, cloth panels and mist layers occupy different large phases rather than peaking together. Foreground mist reaches its widest displacement first, followed by the short outer hair, then the largest white cloth panel, with background mist last. The blue-gray hand remains almost stationary during these large surrounding motions. At 5.06 seconds, the scene remains fully visible and evenly exposed. From 6.80 to 10.13 seconds, every flexible layer follows its smooth closed path back to the opening geometry and loop phase. Motion continues through the final instant without a frozen hold or sudden correction.

Existing bright particles follow short right-to-left-biased loops while retaining their count, size, brightness, color, opacity and depth. They do not approach the camera or cover the character and sword.

Preserve global exposure and the regional average luminance of the face, lilies, pale garments, sword highlights, central glow, bright sky, violet ruins and peripheral areas. Moving fog retains constant regional average opacity, optical density, brightness and color. Pale mist remains translucent and distributed rather than accumulating into an opaque wall. The full character silhouette and background remain continuously visible.

At exactly 10.13 seconds, the character, both real hands, wrist positions, palms, all visible fingers, short-hair shape, sword, lilies, structures and camera match Picture 1. Every moving short hair tuft, garment panel, ribbon, particle and mist layer returns to the opening position, geometry, distribution, travel direction and motion phase. The blue-gray hand remains anatomically stable and returns from its minute passive sway to its exact opening position. The final frame lands precisely on Picture 2 and connects continuously to 0.00 seconds. No cuts, camera motion, scene change, extra or missing fingers, additional hands or limbs, anatomical transformation, sword deformation, exposure ramp, cloud-shadow event, opaque fog wall, fade or black frame.
